reasoning: 12 lazyslide tutorials cluster into 6 independently-triggerable skills. The package itself is the agent — there is ONE OmicOS agent (pathology_lazyslide) that owns all 6 skills and dispatches between them based on the user's request. This matches omicverse_omni precedent: a third-party package gets one front-door agent, not N per-capability agents. The 6 skills are: direct H&E pipeline (preprocessing + tile FM + zero-shot + tile-prediction approx seg + tile export), cell-level segmentation (uses lazyslide.segmentation), supervised classification (consumes known slide-level labels), survival prediction (time-to-event with TITAN), H&E + transcriptomics integration (RNALinker), virtual staining (image generation). Two pedagogy intros are not capabilities.

capabilities.title: Direct H&E whole-slide morphology pipeline with LazySlide
capabilities.distinct_from: Outputs tissue + tile geometry + tile FM features + optional zero-shot probs. Does NOT produce cell-level shapes, molecular predictions, slide-level supervised labels, survival times, or generated images.

capabilities.title: Cell-level segmentation of H&E with LazySlide
capabilities.distinct_from: Per-cell polygons (one row per cell). Different geometric primitive from tissue or tile shapes.

capabilities.title: Slide-level supervised classification with known H&E labels

key_apis.name: wsidata.agg_wsi
key_apis.purpose: stack per-slide features into labeled cohort

capabilities.distinct_from: Requires KNOWN slide-level labels as supervision; outputs trained classifier + per-slide predictions.

capabilities.title: Survival prediction from cancer WSIs with LazySlide TITAN
capabilities.distinct_from: Output is hazard / risk score / time-to-event with censoring; uses TITAN (not UNI/Virchow).

capabilities.title: Paired H&E + transcriptomics integration with LazySlide RNALinker

key_apis.name: lazyslide.tools.RNALinker(agg_features, others, gene_name=None)
key_apis.purpose: link image features to paired RNA-seq; .score(groupby, score_group, scale, test_method, n_features, key_added)

capabilities.distinct_from: Input REQUIRES paired Visium/RNA AnnData in addition to WSI. Prepares aligned (image, expression) and scores feature-gene associations; does NOT predict expression.

capabilities.title: Virtual multiplex staining from H&E with LazySlide

key_apis.name: lazyslide.tools.virtual_stain(wsi, model='gigatime')
key_apis.purpose: generate virtual stain channels; output to wsi.images['gigatime_prediction']; up to 50 biomarker channels

capabilities.distinct_from: Output is GENERATED IMAGES (per-channel stain reconstructions in wsi.images), not geometric shapes or feature tables.

agents.title: Pathology — LazySlide (H&E whole-slide analysis omni-agent)
agents.bundle_rationale: lazyslide is a third-party H&E WSI analysis package. Per OmicVerse precedent (omicverse_omni), an external package gets ONE OmicOS agent that dispatches between its sub-capabilities based on the user's intent. This avoids agent proliferation (6 nearly-identical use_when blocks would be redundant), keeps a single front-door for 'I want to do X with H&E using lazyslide', and matches how OmicOS already surfaces ecosystems.
